story.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利升至第10位发车，而弗朗科尔·拉皮托因更换新部件而排在第21位。
story.originalTitle: Your starting positions for today's #USGP 🤜🤛 @PierreGasly moves up into P10, whilst @francolapinto starts P21 as a result of taking new elements...
story.summaryEn:
Your starting positions for today's #USGP 🤜🤛
@PierreGasly moves up into P10, whilst @francolapinto starts P21 as a result of taking new elements to his Power Unit.
detailZh:
您今天美国大奖赛（#USGP）的起跑位置 🤜🤛
皮埃尔·加斯利（@PierreGasly）上升至第10位起跑，而弗朗科·拉皮托（@francolapinto）由于更换了动力单元的新元件，从第21位起跑。
detailEn:
Your starting positions for today's #USGP 🤜🤛
@PierreGasly moves up into P10, whilst @francolapinto starts P21 as a result of taking new elements to his Power Unit.
